sources.excerpt: Risk statistics are calculated on daily returns over the trailing three years. The Sharpe ratio uses a risk-free rate of 6.50% per annum. Fund Manager Commentary: Markets were range-bound during the half-year. We maintained a diversified large-cap portfolio with technology as the second-largest sector. The fund continues to avoid highly leveraged companies, and cash was held at about 5.8% of net assets to meet redemptions.
